title: Owner Paying Record and the Storage Goodwill Percentage, Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
**Rule.** On a Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement, the goodwill percentage follows the owner's paying record with the network. Two payment records are looked at:

- **(a)** a customer payment made by the owner on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order of their own (a customer payment entry in that repair order's ledger);
- **(b)** a card payment by which an estimate-stage charge of this booking was paid.

An owner who has both records receives a goodwill percentage of **6%** (0.06); an owner with exactly one of those two payment records receives **4%** (0.04); an owner with neither record is not given a percentage under this table.

| (a) Customer payment on own Insurance Claim Repairs order | (b) Card payment on a charge of this booking | Goodwill percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 6% |
| Yes | No | 4% |
| No | Yes | 4% |
| No | No | not set by this table |

**Points of judgement** (hypothetical owners)

- An owner who made a customer payment toward the balance of their own insurance claim repair order and paid this booking's teardown charge by card has both records: 6%.
- An owner who paid this booking's scan charge by ACH and has no insurance claim repair order: neither record — a payment by ACH is not a card payment.
- An owner whose only record is a card payment on this booking: exactly one record, 4%.
